title: Card failures concentrated on BIN 400000 (issuer timeouts)
root_cause: Issuer behind BIN 400000 returned timeouts through acquirer acq_a.
fix_applied: Rerouted BIN 400000 to acquirer acq_b until the issuer recovered.
resolution_notes: Failure rate returned to baseline within 20 minutes of the reroute; reroute reverted next day.

title: UPI collect requests expiring
root_cause: Remitter bank PSP latency above the collect timeout.
fix_applied: Extended the collect timeout from 5 to 8 minutes.
resolution_notes: Recurred on 2026-09-27; PSP has since added capacity.

title: Card-testing burst on a low-ticket merchant
root_cause: Bot submitting sub-1.00 USD authorizations with enumerated cards.
fix_applied: Enabled velocity rule (>= 10 micro-amount attempts per 10 minutes per merchant) and CAPTCHA.
resolution_notes: No further bursts for 14 days; rule kept enabled.

title: Settlement payout lower than expected
root_cause: Chargeback fees and rolling reserve were not shown in the merchant's own calculation.
fix_applied: Sent itemized settlement breakdown and added reserve line to the statement.
resolution_notes: Merchant confirmed the breakdown matched their records.

title: Acquirer acq_b elevated soft declines
fix_applied: Traffic weight on acq_b reduced from 50% to 30%.
